nodes.label: Test Before Prod Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Prod never moves before the testing env is smoke-verified; testing tag disposable, stable tag only written by CI or deploy.sh; immutable sha and version tags are rollback targets.

nodes.label: Image Tag Layout
nodes.rationale: Mutable testing/stable tags for current builds plus immutable branch, sha, and version tags for traceability and rollback.

nodes.label: Android Kiosk Shell
nodes.rationale: WebView shell with immersive sticky bars and lock task is built and installed by hand, outside deploy.sh and CI; boardUrl is a build.gradle resValue, android excluded from the docker build context.

nodes.label: Self Hosted CI Runner
nodes.rationale: Single self-hosted k8s runner with DinD deploys both envs; kubeconfig mounted as a file via ServiceAccount so no GitHub Secrets are needed.
